commands: @echo '  make discover-system         - Discover all system capabilities'
@echo '  make validate-targets        - Validate all Makefile targets'
@echo '  make test-system            - Run comprehensive system tests'
@echo '  make beast-deploy           - Deploy Beast Mode framework'
@echo '  make beast-test             - Run Beast Mode tests'
@echo '  make beast-compliance       - Check Beast Mode compliance'
@echo '  make beast-fix              - Fix Beast Mode issues'
@echo '  make beast-metrics          - Generate Beast Mode metrics'
@echo '  make beast-validate-all     - Validate Beast Mode framework'
@echo '  make governance-scan        - Scan for orphaned solutions'
@echo '  make generate-reports       - Generate all system reports'
@curl -s http://localhost:8888/health || echo '❌ Observatory health check failed'
@curl -s http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || echo '❌ Prometheus health check failed'
@curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health || echo '❌ Grafana health check failed'
@docker logs beast-mode-observatory --tail=50 2>/dev/null || echo 'Observatory container not running'
@docker logs observatory-prometheus --tail=20 2>/dev/null || echo 'Prometheus container not running'
@docker logs observatory-grafana --tail=20 2>/dev/null || echo 'Grafana container not running'
python scripts/check_dag_status.py || echo 'DAG status check attempted'
@lsof -i:6379 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ Redis is running' || echo '❌ Redis is not running'
@lsof -i:5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ PostgreSQL is running' || echo '❌ PostgreSQL is not running'
@lsof -i:9090 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ Prometheus is running' || echo '❌ Prometheus is not running'
